Sampled stomachs of the ICES example data, empty ones included

Source: R/data.R
ices_stomachs.Rd

One row per stomach sampled in the hauls of ices_diet: 8,886 stomachs of 23 predator species, of which 1,197 are flagged empty. Stomachs without any prey record do not appear in ices_diet, so this table is the one to use for the proportion of empty stomachs or the number of fish sampled per stratum.

Usage

ices_stomachs

Format

A data frame with 8,886 rows and 20 columns: stomach_id, haul_id, country, survey, year, month, quarter, lat, lon, ices_rectangle, depth_m, region, predator_aphia_id, predator_latin, predator_common, n_fish_pooled, length_cm, weight_g, stomach_empty, regurgitated (as in ices_diet).

Source

As ices_diet.

Examples

# share of stomachs flagged empty, by predator
e <- tapply(ices_stomachs$stomach_empty %in% 1, ices_stomachs$predator_common, mean)
round(100 * sort(e, decreasing = TRUE), 1)[1:5]
#>      Twaite shad       Blonde ray           Turbot Atlantic halibut 
#>            100.0             50.0             40.0             33.3 
#>  European plaice 
#>             30.1
